test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements A and B are given. There may be a cause-and-effect relationship between the two statements. These two statements may be the effect of the same cause or independent causes. These statements may be independent causes without having any relationship. Read both the statements and select the appropriate option.

Statements:

A) KBCL decided to sell their oil to Alliance.

B) Alliance has raised the procurement price of oil from the last month.

options.text: Both the statements, A and B, are effects of independent causes
B is the cause and A is the effect
A is the cause and B is the effect
Both the statements, A and B, are independent causes.

solution:
The logic followed is:

Seller will sell their commodities if the price of that commodities is higher than previous time. As Alliance has raised the procurement price or cost price of oil from the last month, KBCL decided to sell their oil to Alliance. So, statement B is the cause and statement A is the effect.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
